I am an Assistant Professor in the Department of Economics at Sciences Po. I was a Postdoctoral Researcher at the Columbia University Center for Political Economy in 2025-2026.
I work on questions in environmental economics, empirical industrial organization and labor economics. I received my PhD in Sustainable Development from Columbia University.

I go by Emma and use she/her pronouns.
